before_exact_dictionaries.note: THE WITNESS DOES NOT PRINT THIS DAY. Read on the 1861 page images on 2026-08-20: leaf n538 (printed p. 530) carries the Mass of `VIII. CONCEPTION of the B. V. M.`, and leaf n539 (printed p. 531, running head `11th AND 13th DECEMBER.`) carries that Mass's end and then `XI. St. DAMASUS, p. c.` There is no 10 December formulary between them. The 1862 prints this Mass only in its `pro aliquibus locis` appendix, which the 1861 lay missal does not carry. Nothing is carried. Incipit of the Latin refused here: `Deus, qui beatae Mariae Virginis domum`. Read on the page image https://archive.org/download/romanmissaltran00churgoog/page/n539_w1400.jpg (leaf n539, printed p. 531, heading `11th AND 13th DECEMBER.`) by lane pc-antecedent-english on 2026-08-20. The later unofficial-web rows were rejected as authoritative exemplars; their wording was quarantined and is represented only by the SHA-256 fingerprint above.
